description:
[Deterministic XBRL financial statement normalizer. Pure calculation & parsing, read-only, side-effect free]. Parses and normalizes raw European XBRL instance documents (IT OIC, DE HGB, FR PCG, EU IFRS) into standardized financial indicators: EBITDA, EBIT, Net Financial Debt (PFN), Working Capital (CCN), Solvency ratio, and Current ratio with decimal.js precision.
Usage: Use this tool to ingest statutory annual reports and extract comparable financial ratios for credit, M&A, or vendor due diligence.
Returns: JSON object with { reportingStandard: string, companyName: string, fiscalYear: number, reclassifiedBalanceSheet: object, reclassifiedIncomeStatement: object, financialRatios: object, creditRiskIndicator: object }.

companyVatOrId.description: Company national tax ID or VAT number

cashAndEquivalentsEur.description: Cash and liquid equivalents in EUR

currentLiabilitiesEur.description: Current liabilities (debiti a breve) in EUR

revenueEur.description: Total revenues / Valore della produzione in EUR

totalAssetsEur.description: Total balance sheet assets in EUR

name: xbrl_statement_normalizer
